audit.whatIsWrong: All seven level-chart rows disagreed with their own why text: chart said Skill at Level 1 where whys[0] says Shen owns it; Shen at Level 2 where whys[1] calls it a wash; Shen at Level 3 and Skill at 4-5 and 6 where whys[2]/[3]/[4] all describe Ornn taking over; Shen at first item and 2+ where whys[5]/[6] say the edge narrows to even.
audit.why: The prose read matches the kit and the packet chart exactly. Shen's level-1 strength is Spirit's Refuge zoning autos plus an empowered Twilight Assault; Ornn's takeover is Bellows Breath at 3 and the E-into-Q-pillar knock-up at 4-5; at 6 Ornn's double knock-up beats a 600-range dash-taunt; late, two tanks with global-vs-item value flatten out.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Shen, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Skill across both layers with matching ratings, as one atomic pair-group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 said only 'Shen's ultimate changes the math' and never described what Stand United actually is or does to the lane.
audit.why: Stand United is a 200/180/160s global channel that shields an ally then teleports Shen to them. Its lane relevance is not a duel spike at all — it is a map-pressure spike, and it is interruptible.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten around the channel interrupt plus Ornn's R advantage; 2+ items rewritten around global pressure vs Masterwork value.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most valuable interaction in this matchup appeared nowhere: Stand United is a channel, and Ornn's Bellows Breath (or any of his CC) interrupts it. Also missing: Ornn's Q grounds, and its pillar is terrain, so it denies Shadow Dash — Shen's only mobility. And Spirit's Refuge was described loosely enough to imply it blocks Ornn's abilities.
audit.why: Shen's R carries the 'channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it' flag and Riot's text confirms the shield-then-teleport sequence. Spirit's Refuge's Riot text is 'Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — attacks, not abilities, so Volcanic Rupture, Searing Charge and Call of the Forge God all land through it. Shadow Dash carries the dash flag against Ornn's grounding and terrain flags.
audit.corrected: All three stated: R-channel interrupt in tldr, report[5], breakdown.cooldowns, phases[4].why and wants.you[2]; Q-grounds-Shadow-Dash in tldr, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns; attacks-not-abilities in dontsFull[1].d and phases[2].why.

audit.why: Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and costs 150 energy — an enormous window at rank 1. Spirit's Refuge 16s. Stand United 200s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and phases[3].why.
